Quick compliance notes (inline):

- BYOK/KMS: We currently support customer-managed keys (BYOK) for Private deployments and for Dedicated hosts via KMS integrations. For the Hosted API (our multi-tenant offering), we do not provide customer-held keys today — keys are managed by Redwood. We can offer an "escrow"/custodian option for hosted in certain enterprise contracts but that requires legal + product approval and is an exception.

- Audit logs: We can produce event-level audit logs for authentication, admin actions, and exports. Default retention is 1 year in the hosted product; we have a roadmap item to support long-term retention (+3 years) behind an add-on. Seven-year retention is not currently supported in hosted without an archived export process (we can export to S3 buckets for long-term storage under customer control).

- Data retention / deletion: We support per-customer retention settings in Private/Dedicated. Hosted supports tenant-wide retention but not arbitrary per-application carveouts. Proof-of-deletion artifacts can be generated for data stored in our object store; for complete auditability we recommend S3 archival combined with signed manifests.

- SSO/SCIM: We support SAML 2.0 SSO for both Hosted and Dedicated; SCIM provisioning is supported for Dedicated and Private, hosted SCIM is currently on the roadmap but not yet GA.

Suggested external messaging: provide two options — (1) Dedicated or Private deployment with full BYOK + SCIM + extended retention (timeline: immediate provisioning; 2–4 week onboarding), or (2) Hosted with key-escrow + export-based 7y archive (timeline: immediate for hosting, archive automation 2–3 weeks). Note: both options will have cost delta for extended retention.

I can draft the compliance language and evidence list (SOC 2 + sample audit extract + S3 export manifest example).

— Marissa
Director, Compliance & Trust
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: MedSys security questionnaire — BYOK, retention, SSO, audit logs

Operational feasibility notes:

- Audit retention: our telemetry and audit pipeline can retain the specified event classes for 1 year in the main system. We already have an archival export job (INF-2147) that can push structured audit events to customer S3 for indefinite retention. The export job preserves event ordering and includes checksums for integrity. Setting up automated 7y retention in customer S3 is standard practice.

- Cost: storing high-volume audit data for 7 years increases storage and retrieval costs; we should propose a tiered approach (hot 90 days, warm 1 year, cold/archive in S3 Glacier). I'll model estimated monthly costs for MedSys based on their token/usage projections — need Eli to share expected monthly QPS and retention classes.

- BYOK: for Dedicated/Private, BYOK is supported and we rotate per-customer keys. For Hosted, we can offer a key-escrow arrangement where keys are held in a restricted escrow and access requires a documented legal process. That arrangement has to go through Contracts + Security review; typical turnaround is 2–3 weeks.

Link to the export feature ticket: JIRA:INF-2147 (audit-export-to-s3).

— Ben
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference

Hi Eli / MedSys team,

Thanks for sending the questionnaire. We reviewed your asks and want to offer two pragmatic paths so procurement can proceed:

Option A — Dedicated or Private (recommended for full control)
- BYOK/KMS: supported (customer-managed keys integrated with your KMS).
- Audit logs: configurable event-level retention; can meet 7-year requirement via our managed export to your S3 (we maintain integrity checks and manifests).
- SSO + SCIM: supported.
- Timeline: provisioning and onboarding ~2–4 weeks.

Option B — Hosted with archival + key escrow (for faster time-to-prod)
- BYOK: hosted does not offer customer-held keys by default; we can provide a key-escrow arrangement under an exception.
- Audit logs: default retention 1 year; we will enable automated export to your S3 for 7-year archival.
- SSO: SAML supported; SCIM on roadmap (ETA Q4).
- Timeline: Hosted + exports immediate; key-escrow legal review 2–3 weeks.

Next steps requested from your side:
1) Confirm preferred option (A or B) and whether MedSys will provide an S3 bucket for archives.
2) Share estimated monthly usage (approx tokens/month or average QPS) so Ben can provide storage/cost estimates.
3) If Option B is required, confirm procurement is OK with a key-escrow flow and we will route legal/security approval.

Deliverables from Redwood (we will provide):
- Compliance evidence bundle: SOC 2 report + sample audit extract + export manifest template (attached).
- Implementation plan and timeline (once option chosen).

Attaching a short evidence stub for procurement to review. Happy to hop on the scheduled Thu sync if helpful — otherwise we can close this in email.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
